# Honest Invoice

> Free AI-powered invoicing and estimates for mechanics, handymen, contractors, and freelancers. Create invoices, send by email with a Pay Now button (Stripe), export PDFs, and work fully offline.

Honest Invoice is a free invoice template and generator built for trades and field service workers. Describe a job in plain English and the AI fills in itemized line items, labor, and parts. Send invoices by email with a Stripe-powered Pay Invoice button, export branded PDFs, and manage clients — all on web, Android, and iOS, with full offline support.
